fields.statement: Verified at d0200787 (leaf commits 2c0166a7 and d0200787). I read the diff. In a normal run, adviseQuestion starts one advisor on a question node and journals an advisor entry whose Asker is the node ID. It is called from endLeaf (failed leaf), from capped (review cycle cap) and from arbitrateAsked (a session-less asked entry from a command step, as run review-check writes for plan-review questions; each question is advised once). run recommend takes --restatement, journalled as restated, and the inbox gate item shows it as restatement / 'in plain words', with the template statement unchanged. Ran go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/api/...: ok. TestLeafFailureStartsAdvisor, TestCycleCapQuestionStartsAdvisor and TestCommandAskedNormalRunStartsAdvisor use a fake runner. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-question-advisor|inbox-gate-questions|inbox-advisor|describe-golden|run-review.*)$': all PASS. In inbox-question-advisor.txtar a fake claude advisor launched on a plan-review-style question node runs rhiza run recommend with restatement, recommendation and reasons. One advisor entry and the recommended entry are journalled against the node ID, and rhiza inbox --json shows restatement, recommendation and reasons on the gate-q item. describe-golden includes run.recommend's restatement. Both earlier findings (f1, f2) are addressed.
